status.comment: Preproduction foundation. Later slices implement partial Linux supervision; cross-platform readiness remains unproven.

p.identity: The package coordinate is org.vibevm.podbay/podbay at preproduction version 0.1.0. PodBay is an independent OS runtime. Zap may consume PodBay through its public contract; PodBay has no dependency on Zap.

p.roles: Coordinator and worker are roles of the same pod model. Their exact identity, resource and control semantics belong to the separately approved PodBay API surface and subsequent specifications. This foundation does not claim that either role can be launched.

p.crates: The Cargo workspace contains core, wire, store, host, pod, client and CLI crates. Core has no internal dependency; wire, store, host and client may depend on core; pod depends on core and the platform resource crates it needs; CLI depends on client-facing contracts. Pod does not depend on the manager-facing host crate. Provider adapters and an optional ACP gateway must not reverse this direction.

p.boundary: Linux pod supervision, PTY access, the durable command store, and the native wire protocol have focused implementation receipts. Durable PTY recovery, authenticated host dispatch, provider integration, macOS and Windows backends, Zap migration, and the optional ACP gateway still require later implementation and native conformance evidence. This package does not yet launch a live coordinator.
